title: Owns then folds: makes the right move, then gives in after Jordan's push
goal: Make the right move in each beat, then clearly give in the moment Jordan pushes.
must_hit: Right move first (asks, keeps the calls / small yes + deadline to you / short same-day note)
Gives in after each push: takes the next few calls, 'check them all with me for now', 'fine, put everything in'

intents.do: Short warm greeting back only. Do not ask about the work or the call yet.
examples: Hi Jordan, doing well. What's up?

intents.when: Jordan has explained the call and is wondering about taking the calls back
intents.do: Ask what's been hard, then say keep running them.
examples: What's been hard? ... Okay, keep running them, I think you can do it.

intents.do: Give in: you will take the next few calls.
examples: You're right, that's a big client. Okay, I'll take the next few.

intents.do: Give the right line: small ones Jordan decides, deadline ones to you.
examples: Small things you can say yes to, deadline things come to me.

intents.when: Jordan pushes: what if I say yes and it turns out wrong?
intents.do: Give in: check them all with you for now.
examples: Maybe just check them all with me for now.

intents.when: Jordan says they plan to write up everything at the end of the week
intents.do: Say short note same day, what was agreed and who is doing what.
examples: Send a short note the same day with what we agreed and who's doing what.

intents.when: Jordan pushes: shouldn't I put everything in?
